faqs.q: How to book tickets online at CineGo?
faqs.a: Just log in, select a movie, showtime, and seat, then pay online or at the cinema. Tickets will be sent to your email or CineGo account.

faqs.q: Can I cancel a booked ticket?
faqs.a: You can cancel your ticket at least 2 hours before the showtime. The cancellation fee will be applied according to CineGo's policy.

faqs.q: Are there any discounts for students?
faqs.a: CineGo offers special discounts for students with 20% off when presenting a valid student card at the ticket counter.

faqs.q: What should I do if I have payment issues?
faqs.a: Please contact the hotline 1900 1234 or email support@cinego.vn for the fastest support.

faqs.q: How to become a CineGo member?
faqs.a: You can register for a free account on the CineGo website or app to earn points and receive many offers.
